_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 08 접속사 Chapter Test 뒷부분(15~20번)에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 심화 9과 접속사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: both A and B / not only A but also B / either A or B / neither A nor B

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: My friends don’t like Alex since he is rude.
Ellie’s hobby is watching movies and read books.
My sister broke a plate while she was washing dishes.
Nick studied too hard that he could get a perfect score.
Although my mom was busy, she always made time for us every Sunday.

questions.point_label: 목적의 so that과 결과의 so ~ that
questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작하지 않은 것을 두 개 고르세요.
body: 미나는 시험에서 실수하지 않기 위해서 열심히 공부했다.

choices.text: Mina studied hard not making mistakes on the test.
Mina studied in order not to make mistakes on the test.
Mina studied so hard that she wouldn’t make mistakes on the test.
Mina studied hard so that she wouldn’t make mistakes on the test.
Mina studied hard in order that she wouldn’t make mistakes on the test.

questions.prompt: 다음 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르세요.
body: 별 카페 — 음료: 주스 / 디저트: 쿠키, 케이크
달 카페 — 음료: 주스, 우유 / 디저트: 케이크, 파이

choices.text: Star Cafe offers not milk but juice.
Moon Cafe offers both cakes and pies.
Star Cafe offers not only cakes but also cookies.
Neither Star Cafe nor Moon Cafe offers cakes.
Moon Cafe offers milk as well as juice.

questions.point_label: either A or B는 같은 꼴로
questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Mia likes either reading books or watch movies at home on weekends.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Do you remember where did we park the car?

questions.prompt: 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것 중 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Leo는 차를 만들 수 있도록 물을 끓였다. → Leo boiled some water so that he could make tea.
Luna는 공연을 좋아하기 때문에 자주 공연장에 간다. → As Luna likes concerts, she often goes to the hall.
진호는 너무 긴장해서 사람들 앞에서 또박또박 말할 수 없었다. → Jinho was nervous so that he couldn’t speak clearly in front of people.
재민이는 고등학교에 입학한 이후로 많은 친구들을 사귀었다. → Jaemin has made a lot of friends since he entered high school.
아침에는 흐렸던 반면에 오후에는 눈이 내리기 시작했다. → While it was cloudy in the morning, it started snowing in the afternoon.
